name: Effect: Air of Authority
descr: You take a –2 status penalty to your Will DC against the origin's attempts to Coerce or Demoralize you.

name: Effect: Alchemical Embalming
descr: You take a –10‐foot penalty to all your Speeds.

name: Effect: Apprentice's Ambition
descr: The apprentice gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and skill checks.

name: Effect: Aura of Command
descr: You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack rolls and a +2 status bonus to your Will saves.

name: Effect: Avenge the Fallen
descr: You roll the attack roll twice and use the higher result.

name: Effect: Beguiling Presence
descr: Creatures in the area that can observe the courtesan take a –2 status penalty on their Will DC against the courtesan's attempts to make a Request of them.

name: Effect: Beseech the Spirits
descr: You gain lifesense 60 feet and all-around vision.

name: Effect: Bodyguard's Defense
descr: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Bosun's Command
descr: You gain a +2 status bonus to your attack rolls or a +10 status bonus to your Speeds.

name: Effect: Breach the Outer Rifts
descr: The weapon deals an extra 2d6 damage. Roll 1d20 to determine the type: 1–7 acid, 8–9 cold, 10–11 electricity, 12–18 fire, 19–20 void.

name: Effect: Break Legs!
descr: You become clumsy 1, take a –5‐foot penalty to your Speeds, and have weakness 5 to the origin's Strikes.

name: Effect: Brutal Rally
descr: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls.

name: Effect: Call to Action
descr: The creature gains a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls.

name: Effect: Champion's Aura (Champion of Rovagug)
descr: You take a –1 circumstance penalty to saves against fear.

name: Effect: Chant of Dominance
descr: Any creature damaged this turn also takes 1d6 persistent spirit damage.

name: Effect: Cite Precedent
descr: You gain a -2 circumstance penalty on your next Diplomacy check in a legal argument.

name: Effect: Cleansing Earth
descr: You gain 20 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Commanding Aura
descr: You gain 8 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Competitive Taunt
descr: You get a +2 circumstance bonus to your damage against the creature made off-guard by your taunt.

name: Effect: Conduct the Experiment
descr: Your melee Strikes deal an extra 2d8 precision damage against the marked creature.

name: Effect: Construct Trap
descr: You take a –5 status penalty to all Speeds.

name: Effect: Debilitating Sneak Attack
descr: You either become enfeebled 1 or take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds.

name: Effect: Depth Charge
descr: You take a –2 circumstance penalty to Acrobatics checks to Balance and Athletics checks to Swim. If you critically failed the save you are also deafened.

name: Effect: Diplomatic Immunity
descr: The attacker gains weakness 2 to all damage from the envoy's allies while Diplomatic Immunity lasts, whether their attack was disrupted or not.

name: Effect: Divine Frenzy
descr: You take a –2 penalty to Perception checks and Will saves and gain a +2 status bonus to your spell DC and spell attack modifier. You can't use actions with the [concentrate](/trait/concentrate) trait unless you're Casting a Spell or Seeking.

name: Effect: Don Mask
descr:
The mummer gains a primal boon:

**Fiery Akkarok** The mummer's melee Strikes deal an additional 2d6 fire damage.**Hazi Zephyr-Borne** The mummer gains a fly Speed of 20 feet.**King of Storms** The mummer gains the Reactive Strike reaction that can be used only with their tail.**Nessek, the Wave Dancer** The mummer's claw Strikes deal an additional 2d4 persistent bleed damage.**Zalok, Who was Called to Black Harbor** The mummer gains a +10-foot status bonus to their land Speed and swim Speed.

name: Effect: Eat a Pickle
descr: You gain 4 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Exalted Retributive Strike
descr: You gain resistance 14 to all damage against the triggering damage.

name: Effect: Fanatical Frenzy
descr: You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls, and you take a –2 penalty to AC.

name: Effect: Fickle Prophecy
descr: You gain 1d8+4 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Fiery Rhetoric
descr: You take a –2 status penalty to Perception and Will saves.

name: Effect: Flesh Mutation
descr:
You are affected by a mutation according to the result.

**1 Spongy Flesh** You have weakness 5 to physical damage.

**2 Caustic Blood** You take 2d4 persistent acid damage that can't be removed normally, but ends when the mutation does.

**3 Sprouting Eyes** You are dazzled, but also immune to flanking.

**4 Mutated Mind** You are confused. You can still recover as noted in the condition, but if you do you remain off-guard until the mutation ends.

name: Effect: Follow Me
descr: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception and Stealth checks.

name: Effect: Greased Palms
descr: You gain a +2 status bonus to Gather Information in the sheriff's settlement.

name: Effect: Guard's Parry (Guard)
descr: The palace guard gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attack and damage rolls until the end of their next turn.

name: Effect: Guard's Parry (Liege)
descr: The liege gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

name: Effect: Guide's Warning
descr: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your initiative rolls. This bonus increases to +2 if the guide was Scouting.

name: Effect: Guiding Words (Guide)
descr: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the marked creature.

name: Effect: Harness Wickedness
descr: Your Strikes deal an additional die of damage and gain the [unholy](/trait/unholy) trait. You also gains 10 temporary Hit Points, a +5-foot status bonus to Speed, and weakness 5 to holy.

name: Effect: Hunter's Onslaught
descr: You become fascinated by the marked creature and you gain 10 temporary Hit Points that last as long as the onslaught does. You gain a +8 status bonus to damage rolls against the marked enemy, and allies in a 30-foot aura around the hunter gain half that bonus.

name: Effect: Hurl Net
descr: On a hit, you are off-guard and take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to your Speeds. On a critical hit, you are restrained instead.

name: Effect: I Am the Law!
descr: You can use your reaction to Grapple, Strike, or Trip with a +2 status bonus.

name: Effect: Imbue Righteousness
descr: Your strikes with that weapon gain the [holy](/trait/holy) trait and deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage to unholy creatures.

name: Effect: Inspirational Presence
descr: Any of the teacher's students in the aura gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge.

name: Effect: Inspiring Aura
descr: You gain a +1 status bonus to initiative rolls and saves against fear effects.

name: Effect: Interest is Due!
descr: Your Strike deals an an additional 1d6 mental damage.

name: Effect: Keep Up With Me!
descr: You gain a +3 status bonus to your attack roll on the next Strike you make, or to the DC of your next offensive ability if you're a troop.

name: Effect: Kingpin's Presence
descr: You gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects.

name: Effect: Liberating Step
descr: You gain resistance 10 to all damage against the triggering damage.

name: Effect: Life Burn Aura
descr: You are surrounded by a 30-foot emanation. While Life Burn Aura is active, your fist Strikes deal 2 additional die of weapon damage.

name: Effect: Magnificent…!
descr:
You gain a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls against the marked creature.

The origin deals an extra 3d6 precision damage with their weapon and unarmed Strikes that hit that creature.

name: Effect: Mark of Fate
descr: You gain weakness 10 to unholy and take a –2 circumstance penalty to Charisma-based skill checks against followers of Urgathoa.

name: Effect: Medical Malpractice
descr: The surgeon's melee Strikes deal extra precision damage against the marked creature.

name: Effect: Monologue
descr: You gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls with your spells. Each time you take this action again, the bonuses increase by 1 and 2, respectively.

name: Effect: Natural Disguise
descr: You gain a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks while in a natural environment until your next daily preparations or until its disguise is ruined, whichever comes first.

name: Effect: Never off the Hook
descr: You take a –3 circumstance penalty to your Will DC against the origin's attempts to Demoralize or Coerce you.

name: Effect: No Fight Fair
descr: You take a status penalty to your speed.

name: Effect: No Quarter!
descr: You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

name: Effect: On Guard
descr: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative roll.

name: Effect: One for All
descr: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. If you would benefit from more than one creature's One for All ability, the bonus is +2 instead of +1.

name: Effect: Owe Money
descr: You owe money.

name: Effect: Perfect Formation
descr: The troop gains a +2 item bonus to AC and a +2 status bonus to Reflex saves.

name: Effect: Posse's Edge
descr: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on initiative rolls.

name: Effect: Remember, You're Under Oath
descr: You take a status penalty to Deception checks to Lie.

name: Effect: Repentant Defiance
descr: You gain resistance 3 to physical damage.

name: Effect: Root in Place
descr: Your Speed is reduced to 0 and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and 2 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Sage's Analysis
descr: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and AC against the marked creature and deal an additional 2d6 damage to the creature with weapon attacks.

name: Effect: Scent of Blood
descr: You 10 temporary HP and a +4 status bonus to damage rolls with your unarmed attacks, but become off-guard.

name: Effect: Shared Confidence
descr: You gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves.

name: Effect: Shields Up!
descr: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves.

name: Effect: Sic 'Em!
descr: You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls.

name: Effect: Sight Prey
descr: The warmonger's ranged Strikes against the marked creature gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and deal an extra 3d6 precision damage. Each time the warmonger hits that creature with a ranged Strike, the creature takes a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute and falls 20 feet if it's flying.

name: Effect: Sight Prey (Speed Penalty)
descr: You take a penalty to your Speeds.

name: Effect: Solidarity
descr: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fatigue and mental effects.

name: Effect: Spear Parry
descr: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Effect: Spill Secrets
descr: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against the marked creature.

name: Effect: Stab it! Stab it! Stab it!
descr: Your attacks against the marked target deal 1 additional damage dice.

name: Effect: Stay in the Fight!
descr: You gain 10 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Stay Strong!
descr: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the save.

name: Effect: Steward of the Faithful
descr: Each ally in the aura who worships Pharasma gains resistance 5 to void and a +1 status bonus to Will saves, Diplomacy checks, and Medicine checks.

name: Effect: Still Got It!
descr: The retired creature gains temporary Hit Points equal to its level that last until the end of the encounter. The retired creature also suppresses the effects of being rusty until the end of the encounter.

name: Effect: Super Qi Blast
descr: For your next casting of the two-action version of *qi blast*, the size of the cone increases to 120 feet and the damage increases to 16d6. You also become one size category larger, dealing an additional +9 damage with your melee Strikes.

name: Effect: Swig
descr: You gain a +2 item bonus to melee damage rolls and saving throws against fear but are off-guard.

name: Effect: Symbol of Loyalty
descr: Allies in the aura who are 14th level and lower and are loyal to the grand inquisitor's cause get a +3 status bonus to Will saves.

name: Effect: Tactical Command
descr: The creature gains a +2 status bonus to their Strike if the veteran noble has dealt with that creature or an organization that creature belongs to before, as the veteran offers hard-earned tactical advice.

name: Effect: Temper Armament
descr: Tempering armor or a shield increases its Hardness by 1. Tempering a weapon grants the weapon a +1 circumstance bonus to damage rolls.

name: Effect: Timely Advice
descr: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering roll.

name: Effect: Tip the Scales
descr: You roll twice on your next d20 roll before the end of your next turn and take the better result.

name: Effect: Unbelievable Connection
descr: The marked creature is off-guard against your attacks until it is no longer stupefied.

name: Effect: Under Command
descr: You are commanded by a captain of the guard.

name: Effect: Verdant Aria
descr: You gain a +2 status bonus to AC and saving throws.

name: Effect: Void Tendrils
descr: When you would be healed by a vitality effect, the healing is reduced by 15.

name: Effect: War Cry
descr: You deal an additional 1d6 damage with your Strikes.

name: Effect: Will Not Falter
descr: You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws against fear.

name: Effect: Words of Encouragement
descr: You ignore any circumstance and status penalties you have.

name: Effect: You'll Pay for That
descr: You gain a +5 status bonus to your next damage roll against the marked enemy.

name: Stance: Hunter's Precision
descr: Your Strikes deal an additional 2d8 precision damage, and the range increment for your ranged weapon Strikes is 20 feet longer than normal. On a critical hit with a weapon Strike, the target also takes 2d6 persistent bleed damage.
